purpose: Model ports and terminals as ownership, logistics, infrastructure and trade nodes with measurable capacity and strategic dependencies.

entity.scope: publicly documented maritime ports and cargo terminals

evidence_model.rule: Distinguish port-wide capacity from individual terminal capacity and announced expansion from commissioned capacity.

validation_rules: ownership and operation are separate facts
cargo categories must not be double-counted across incompatible measures

implementation_notes.canonical_owner: The terminal owns terminal-specific physical and operational facts; port-level facts belong to port records when those are distinct.
implementation_notes.frontend: Show terminal profile plus owner/operator, cargo flows and network dependencies.
known_traps: port and terminal names are often conflated
implementation_notes.research_task: Prioritize European ports that sit on major energy, container, grain or strategic supply-chain routes.
